app.title: Workflow Engine
language.label: Language
projects.loadFailed: The projects could not be loaded.
workflow.heading: Workflow
workflow.generating: The AI is writing the workflow (up to five minutes)...
workflow.changedSince: Changed since contract version {version}; confirm again for the next version.
error.keyMissing: No AI key is set in the engine. Enter one with the key button in the header.
error.keyRejected: The AI provider rejected the key. Enter it again.
error.invalidOutput: The AI's answer was invalid twice. Try again or reword the wish.
brief.heading: Brief
questions.heading: Questions
questions.none: No questions yet. The AI reads your wish, writes a short brief and asks what is still open (at most 8 questions, each with a proposal).
questions.asking: The AI is researching and writing questions (up to five minutes)...
questions.intro: Each question has the AI's proposal preselected. Change what does not fit, then save.
requirements.heading: Requirements
requirements.writing: The AI is writing the requirements (up to five minutes)...
review.heading: Review and confirm
list.title: All projects
list.lead: There is no login. Everyone who opens this engine sees all projects and can continue any of them.
list.notice: To start or continue a run you enter your Anthropic API key. It is kept for your session only and never stored.
list.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" with its questions, requirements, workflow and contracts?
questions.removeText: The question and its answer are removed from the project.
steps.deleteText: The profile "{name}" is deleted. Projects that use it go back to the default profile.
toast.wishSaved: Wish saved. The AI will ask again.
run.stop.title: Stop the run?
wish.title: Describe your idea
wish.lead: Write what your business needs. The AI researches it and asks you questions next.
wish.name: Project name (optional)
wish.wishHint: Who uses it, what should they be able to do, and what matters most?
wish.nameHint: Optional. Without a name the project is called after your wish.
wish.chars: Plain language is best. {count} of {max} characters.
wish.keyLabel: Your Anthropic API key (for this session)
wish.keyNote: You pay the AI provider directly. The key is kept for this session only and never stored: you enter it again in every new session. Using Gemini, OpenAI or another provider? Use the AI key button in the header.
wish.next: Next: the AI researches your idea and prepares questions. This takes about a minute.
wish.editWarning: Changing the wish moves the project back to the first step: the brief and the questions are written again from the new wish. A confirmed contract stays as it is; confirming again makes a new version.
questions.stale: The wish changed. The AI writes the brief and the questions again; the earlier questions and answers are replaced.
questions.editProposal: Proposed answer (one per line; one line unless several options)
workflow.editHelp: Change steps, lanes and arrows, then save. The rules are the same as for the AI draft: one start, at least one end, every step reachable and with an arrow out. A confirmed workflow that you change becomes the next contract version when you confirm again.
documents.heading: Documents
review.answersValue: {answers} answers, {byAi} decided by the AI proposal
review.workflowValue: {tasks} tasks: {software} built by the AI, {manual} manual
review.noLogin: MVP: no login. Everyone who opens this engine can see and continue this project. The generated app has no login and no real payments.
run.heading: Run
run.noneNext: Start the run to build the software from your confirmed contract.
run.waiting.question: The run needs your answer
run.question.heading: Needs your answer: {step}
run.question.hint: Tell the builder what to do (optional)
run.question.skipNote: Skipping marks the step as done without building it.
run.stop.confirmText: Stop the run? It ends here and cannot be continued. What was built up to the last checkpoint can be downloaded.
run.resumeKey: Anthropic key (needed again after a restart)
run.wait.tokens: Waiting for tokens: the rate limit or the credit of the key is used up. The run tries again by itself.
run.wait.cost_limit: The cost limit is reached. Raise it to continue.
run.cost: Cost so far: USD {cost} of USD {limit}
run.interruptedHint: The engine restarted while the run was under way, and the key is gone. Enter the key again and continue from the last checkpoint, or download what was built so far.
run.report.heading: Final report
run.report.resumes: Resumed {count} times after an engine restart
run.report.zipNote: The ZIP contains this report as RUN-REPORT.md.
run.report.failed: The report could not be loaded.
run.reloadHint: You can reload this page: the run goes on and the screen picks it up again.
steps.title: Team and steps
steps.lead: The steps every task of your workflow runs. Choose a profile for this project; to change steps, copy a profile and edit the copy.
steps.optional: This page is optional: without a choice the short profile is used.
steps.prompt: What Claude is told ({task} stands for the task title)
steps.gated: Run the check after this step and require it to pass
steps.problem.title: Give the step a name of up to 80 characters.
steps.problem.prompt: Write what Claude is told, up to 4000 characters.
steps.problem.cap: The cost cap must be above 0 and at most 10.
limits.title: Limits
limits.cost: Cost limit per run (USD, your API key)
limits.hint: The run waits and asks you when it is reached. Empty means the default of USD {default}; from {min} to {max}. Saved when you leave the field.
limits.invalid: Enter an amount from USD {min} to {max} with at most two decimals, or leave it empty.
limits.saved: Saved. A new run uses this limit.
wait.hint: This can take a few minutes. You can leave this page open.
step.questionsLead: The AI reads your wish, writes a short brief and asks what is still open. Check the proposed answers and save them to continue.
step.requirementsLead: Requirements grouped by epic, written from your wish and answers. Read them, then continue to the workflow.
step.workflowLead: Each box is one task in your business, in swimlanes by who does it. Look it over, then continue to the review.
questions.emptyStep: Next step: the AI researches your wish and asks at most 8 questions, each with a proposal already selected.
requirements.emptyStep: Next step: the AI turns your wish and answers into numbered requirements, grouped by epic.
workflow.emptyStep: Next step: the AI draws the business workflow in swimlanes. You can edit it, then confirm it as the contract.
error.next: Nothing was lost. Fix this and press the button again.
key.title: AI keys for this session
key.note: Kept in engine memory only, never stored; gone after an engine restart. Planning (questions, requirements, workflow) can use either provider; building always uses Claude Code with an Anthropic key.
key.kept: The key you saved earlier is unchanged.
key.setHere: A key is already set for this session ({state}). Leave the field empty to keep it, or type another key to replace it.
app.demo: Demo mode: canned answers, no real AI
key.hintGemini: Get a key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey). The free tier has small per-minute and per-day limits.
key.hintOpenai: Keys and billing: platform.openai.com. The account needs credit.
key.hintGroq: Keys: console.groq.com. Not every Groq model supports structured output; the engine then asks for plain JSON.
key.hintOpenrouter: Keys: openrouter.ai/keys. Use a model id from the OpenRouter list.
key.hintCustom: Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI chat API. The URL must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost).
key.planningNone: Planning uses no AI yet: enter a key.
key.warnWrongSlotOpenai: This looks like an Anthropic key (sk-ant-). Put it in the Anthropic field.
key.warnWrongSlotAnthropic: This does not look like an Anthropic key (sk-ant-...). Use the OpenAI-compatible field for Gemini, OpenAI and others.
step.wishLead: The AI works from this text. Read it and continue; edit it only if it is wrong.
step.reviewLead: Check the summary. Confirming freezes it as the contract the software is built from.
step.runLead: Start the run to build the software task by task. You can stop it at any time.
stepper.label: Steps of this project
workflow.confirmFirst: Confirm the contract first; then the run can start.
review.confirmedNext: The contract is confirmed. Continue to start the run.
step.diagramHint: Zoom with the buttons or Ctrl and the mouse wheel; the page scrolls normally.
diagram.fit: Fit the diagram to the view
build.heading: Build with
build.lead: Choose the tool that builds your software. The run starts when the chosen tool is ready.
build.code.claude_not_installed: Claude Code is not installed on this machine.
build.code.gemini_not_installed: Gemini CLI is not installed. Run ci/run install-gemini and restart the engine.
build.code.no_anthropic_key: An Anthropic API key is missing.
build.code.no_gemini_key: A Gemini API key is missing.
build.code.not_signed_in: Claude Code is not signed in on this machine.
builders.claude.signInInstruction: Run claude once in a terminal on this machine and log in, then choose Check again.
build.demo: Demo mode: nothing real is built.
build.errorChoose: Starting failed. Fix what is missing above, then start again.
run.activityEmpty: Nothing yet. What the builder does appears here while it works.
